mission: We are a co-educational, pre-health professional fraternity whose mission is to prepare University of Tampa members for healthcare careers through scholarship, brotherhood, and service. Our chapter is a family of Spartans who celebrate each other’s wins and walk together through the hard parts of the pre-health path, growing as servant leaders, confronting bias, and building character for the clinic and beyond.
history: Mu Epsilon Delta was founded in 1965 at the University of Tennessee at Martin as a national co-educational professional fraternity for students pursuing pre-health careers. Today chapters span the country. The University of Tampa’s chapter, chartered in 2026, is the first pre-health fraternity on campus, carrying that mission onto Plant Hall with a focus on supporting underserved communities throughout Tampa.
foundingStory: National colors are maroon and gold; the symbol is the caduceus; the flower is the red rambling rose; the jewel is the ruby. Our motto: “With purity and passion I pass my life and practice my art.” At UT we live that vow through scholarship cohorts, Tampa Bay service (including Gift of Life Bone Marrow Registry drives), and a brotherhood that shows up for one another.
chapterBlurb: We take heavy strides to support underserved communities across the city of Tampa while building the academic, clinical, and leadership habits healthcare careers demand.

president.name: Bridget Klaus
president.quote: I'm endlessly grateful for this fraternity, a community that has given me some of my best friends. My goal is to build an engaging, service-focused environment where every brother's aspirations can come to fruition, because brotherhood means truly showing up for the people counting on you. To anyone considering healthcare: keep being your best self, help others in everything you do, and champion the people around you. Thank you all. I wouldn't be who I am today without you.
